selection: Use the frozen population's parent-hash development/confirmation split; hash-ranked distinct source IDs, alternating M/K, no photometric or detector selection. Balanced depth strata assigned before reading light curves.
geometry: Circular physical transit models with host-specific fiducial density inferred from frozen Mamajek dwarf-sequence mass/radius at Gaia temperature; these are not measured properties of individual hosts. Quadratic limb-darkening coefficients are drawn from the declared physical sensitivity prior.
injection: Add a deterministic per-quarter source-baseline decrement before unchanged LC2 preparation and shallow-detector detrending; preserve observed noise, errors, quality flags, missing cadences and archive masks.
claim_boundary: Detector-only flux-level recovery conditional on archived KBonus extraction in the recorded photometry view. PSF_FLAT trials additionally condition on upstream flattening. Full PSF is preferred; SAP is used only where full PSF is unavailable, with the input-only choice recorded. No vetting, localization, validation, occurrence rate or upstream extraction completeness is measured.
